title: 2.4 Protozoa
description: Single-celled eukaryotic protists, their movement, feeding, life stages and reproduction. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A unicellular eukaryote that feeds on organic matter
Which term matches this description? A temporary extension of the cell used for movement
Which term matches this description? A short hair-like structure that beats to move a cell
Which term matches this description? A long whip-like appendage that propels the cell forward
Which term matches this description? The active feeding stage of a protozoan life cycle
Which term matches this description? A resting stage that helps a protozoan survive harsh conditions
Which term matches this description? The process of engulfing solid food particles into a cell
Which term matches this description? A structure that expels excess water from a cell
Which term matches this description? The membrane-bound organelle that contains the cell DNA
Which term matches this description? Movement using temporary extensions of the cell surface
Which term matches this description? A protozoan covered with rows of cilia used for movement
Which term matches this description? A protozoan that moves using one or more flagella
Which term matches this description? A protozoan that moves and feeds using pseudopods
Which term matches this description? A protozoan that forms spores and lacks locomotory structures
Which term matches this description? A protozoan that derives nutrients from a living host
Which term matches this description? A protozoan that lives independently in soil or water
Which term matches this description? A form of asexual reproduction producing two equal cells
Which term matches this description? Asexual reproduction producing many daughter cells at once
Which term matches this description? The process of forming a protective wall around a cell
Which term matches this description? The emergence of a protozoan from its resting cyst
